answer: Because the wander index resolves every citation against the horizon checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the sparrow audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 186 aliases therefore forfeits the authoring cost 186 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 3956 identities would post 2444 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
